raw_response: {"diagnosis": "27 txn_ids were re-delivered as record_version=2 rows, and the silver step keeps both versions. This duplicates keys in silver and double-counts those transactions in every gold table. The fix keeps only the latest version of each txn_id (highest record_version, then latest ingest_ts) before applying the POSTED filter, so a later version that is no longer POSTED drops out.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) t WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
